name: document-type-record-in-metadata
summary: Function hook: write the intake decision (initialize on intake queues) and any human correction (updated, human validation source) of the document type into annotation.metadata, so it survives a re-import.

document_type_field.description: schema id of the document-type enum field; the same value in all three routing parts

metadata_key.description: annotation.metadata key that carries the type; the same value in the Record and Restore parts

provenance: Lifted from a production function hook (test 2026-11-12/13, production 2026-11-16), generalized: the field id and metadata key became seams, and the human-correction path now reads metadata fresh before its PATCH, as the intake path already did. Verified live: the engine's prediction is in the initialize payload (rir_confidence present, no human source). The generalized fragment, seams filled with the defaults, passed 6 Record cases on the real txscript 1.2.0 runtime with a stubbed rossum_api client (not committed: the repo has no harness for running part fragments). Senior-SA sign-off for standard: JŠ (2026-11-25).
notes: Writes annotation.metadata, not a schema field, so produces is empty and the dependency on the Restore part is declared in requires. Uses the rossum_api client (needs the runtime's default third-party library pack), unlike the urllib-based parts. annotation_content.updated blocks the validation screen while it runs and fires on every field edit: about 0.2 s warm, 4.3-5.0 s on a cold start. Moving the correction capture to annotation_content.confirm runs it once per confirm instead; still blocking.
